messages.author: 4e65f2c0cf036a91
messages.subject: Confidence interval from multiple imputation
parts:
Hello,

Is it possible to get standardized CI after multiple imputation?

I have run this command to get

model_six_fit_lv <- semTools::sem.mi(model_six, data = dataset,
                        m = 10, seed = 123, miPackage = "mice",
              fun = "sem", "std.lv", "std.all")

When I run summary(model_six_fit_lv, fit.measures = TRUE, ci = TRUE, rsquare = T, standardized = TRUE), I get CI for 'std.lv' but not for 'std'all'.

To get the standardized CI, I run
standardizedSolution(model_six_fit_lv,  type = "std.all",
                             pvalue = TRUE, ci = TRUE,
                             level = 0.95)

But this doesn't return CI. It only returns the standardized estimate.

When I run parameterEstimates(model_six_fit_lv, se = TRUE), it shows an error
Error in `$<-.data.frame`(`*tmp*`, "z", value = numeric(0)) :
  replacement has 0 rows, data has 167

Is there anything else I can do to get standardized CI? Thanks for your help.

Regards,
Shamika

parts: Is it possible to get standardized CI after multiple imputation?

I have run this command to get

model_six_fit_lv <- semTools::sem.mi(model_six, data = dataset,
                        m = 10, seed = 123, miPackage = "mice",
              fun = "sem", "std.lv", "std.all")
What do you expect the highlighted character strings are doing?  Those are not arguments for sem.mi(), nor for semList(), which is where ... arguments get passed.
When I run summary(model_six_fit_lv, fit.measures = TRUE, ci = TRUE, rsquare = T, standardized = TRUE), I get CI for 'std.lv' but not for 'std'all'.
I doubt that.  I expect you get a CI for the unstandardized parameters, which is the only thing I programmed to be returned.

To get the standardized CI, I run
standardizedSolution(model_six_fit_lv,  type = "std.all",
                             pvalue = TRUE, ci = TRUE,
                             level = 0.95)

But this doesn't return CI. It only returns the standardized estimate.
The standardizedSolution() function is for lavaan objects, not for lavaan.mi objects.
When I run parameterEstimates(model_six_fit_lv, se = TRUE), it shows an error
The parameterEstimates() function is for lavaan objects, not for lavaan.mi objects.
Is there anything else I can do to get standardized CI?
